connector.name: Notion MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Token-auth Notion MCP: pages, databases, blocks, comments, files. Runs headless in CI and agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package notion-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the awkoy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NOTION_TOKEN
env.description: Notion Personal Access Token (ntn_...) or Internal Integration Secret. Create at https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens

env.name: NOTION_PAGE_ID
env.description: Optional default parent page ID used by create_page / create_database when no parent is passed.
